parameters.help_en: The operation that you want to perform. Set the value to ListNodes

parameters.name: program_type

parameters.help_en: The page number. Minimum value: 1. Maximum value: 100
parameters.name: page_number

parameters.help_en: The environment in which the node runs. Valid values: DEV and PROD

parameters.help_en:
The scheduling type. Valid values:

NORMAL: Nodes are scheduled as expected.

PAUSE: Nodes are paused.

SKIP: Nodes are dry-run. Dry-run nodes are started as scheduled, but the system sets the status of the nodes to successful when it starts to run them
parameters.help_zh:
调度的类型，取值如下：
NORMAL：正常调度任务。
PAUSE：暂停任务。
SKIP：空跑任务，被日常调度，但启动调度时直接被置为成功
parameters.name: scheduler_type
